notes.title: Main Menu Update
notes.notes:
Hi Adventurers!!
The Main Menu Update is Out Now!
In this update, We brought to you a massive update that brings a new main menu, bug fixes and more!

Here's the Changelog:

Added:

-New Main Menu
-New Options Menu (Audio, Video, Languages and more)
-Brand new menu Font
-Option of Skip the first cutscene 


Fixed:

-Character Won't fall from platforms while press "down" (now use: "Left Analog Stick down" + "Xbox Button A" to fall from platforms or in keyboard use: "Down Arrow" + "spacebar")

-Performance issues
-Game Crash




Removed

And we have bad news, most recently, we ended the contract with Sedoc LLC, and, as consequence, we have to end the support for the following languages:

-Czech
-Turkish
-Spanish
-Italian
-Russian
-German
-Chinese



The game will have a big change on the next year, and we'll enable those languages, we appreciate your understanding and apologize to the players of these respective languages, but we will do our best to enable these languages ​​in the game soon

That's it, let us know of any bugs that might come up so we can fix it right away! a hug to everyone and see you next time.


Best

Team

OWG Studios

notes.title: Abyss The Forgotten Past EA Release Jan. 29th!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38277840/644fbde649c69c2d403f22b76f4f8a86d3036757.png

Hi everyone! 

We are super excited to announce that we will be releasing the game TOMORROW, Jan. 29th around 12pm ET. We have taken all the feedback we could on the prologue and improved the game. We will continue taking your feedback to improve the game.

About The Game
Abyss The Forgotten Past, is a 2D platform game with RPG-based mechanics, with a large diversity of collectible items, increasing the difficulty as you progress. Enemies may look silly, but they are very smart, so be careful!

Play as Leonnor who sets out on a journey to discover everything about his past and his world, things are not always what they seem! Learn special abilities, battle monsters, and encounter celestial beings as you explore this beautifully crafted pixel world.
